_meta.definition: The process of managing flights, including scheduling, airline assignment, and airplane allocation.

airplane._description: Tracks aircraft details, including unique identifiers, capacity, type, and associated airline.

columns.name: airplane_id
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in airplane

columns.name: capacity
columns.description: Stores the maximum number of passengers an airplane can carry.

columns.name: type_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the type_ entity

columns.name: airline_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the airline_ entity

flight._description: Tracks scheduled flights between airports, including airline and aircraft details.

columns.name: flight_id
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in flight

columns.name: flightno
columns.description: Stores up to 10 alphanumeric flight identifiers for aircraft journeys, typically in Air France format.

columns.name: from
columns.description: Stores airport identification codes for flight origin.

columns.name: to
columns.description: Stores airport IDs of destinations for flights.

columns.name: departure
columns.description: Stores departure times for flights in a format of YYYY-MM-DD HH:MI:SS.

columns.name: arrival
columns.description: Stores scheduled arrival times for flights in a format of YYYY-MM-DD HH:MI:SS.

columns.name: airline_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the airline_ entity

columns.name: airplane_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the airplane_ entity

flightschedule._description: Captures scheduled flights' details including flight number, origin, destination, departure and arrival times, airline ID, and daily operation status.

columns.name: flightno
columns.description: Stores up to 10 alphanumeric flight identifiers for scheduled flights.

columns.name: from
columns.description: Stores airport identification numbers for flight departures.

columns.name: to
columns.description: Stores flight destination identifiers as integer codes.

columns.name: departure
columns.description: Stores departure times in a 10-character format (HH:MM:SS).

columns.name: arrival
columns.description: Stores arrival times in 24-hour format (HH:MM:SS).

columns.name: airline_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the airline_ entity

columns.name: monday
columns.description: Stores whether a flight is scheduled on Mondays (true for 1, false for 0)

columns.name: tuesday
columns.description: Indicates whether a flight is scheduled on Tuesdays (true for 1, false for 0).

columns.name: wednesday
columns.description: Stores whether a flight is scheduled on Wednesdays (true for 1, false for 0)

columns.name: thursday
columns.description: Indicates whether a flight is scheduled on Thursdays (true for 1, false for 0).

columns.name: friday
columns.description: Stores whether a flight is scheduled on Fridays (true for 1, false for 0)

columns.name: saturday
columns.description: The boolean column indicates if a flight is scheduled on Saturdays.

columns.name: sunday
columns.description: Stores whether a flight is scheduled on Sundays (true=1, false=0)
